title: [EPIC] snipurl: a URL shortener service
description:
Build a small, well-tested URL shortener service.

This epic is the sprint root. Its children are the deliverable scope; no work beyond them is in scope.

## Definition of done

- All child issues closed with passing tests.
- 'docker compose up' brings the service up on port 8080.
- The integration test playbook passes end to end against the running service.

## Non-goals

- User accounts, authentication, or a web UI.
- Custom domains or vanity codes.
- Any persistence backend other than SQLite.

title: Dockerfile, compose, and README
description:
Make the service runnable by someone who has just cloned it.

## Acceptance criteria

- A Dockerfile builds the service into a runnable image.
- `docker compose up` starts it on port 8080 with a persistent volume for the
  SQLite file.
- The container passes a healthcheck against `GET /health`.
- The README documents every endpoint with a working `curl` example, plus both
  environment variables.
- A fresh clone can go from `git clone` to a working short link using only the
  README.

## Depends on

Integration test suite.

title: Integration test suite
description:
Verify the whole service end to end against a running instance.

## Acceptance criteria

- Tests run against a live server over HTTP, not the in-process test client.
- Covers the full journey: create a code, follow it, read its stats, confirm the
  click count moved.
- Covers the rate limit returning 429 under sustained requests.
- The suite is runnable with a single command and exits non-zero on failure.
- The suite cleans up its database file afterwards.

## Depends on

Click analytics endpoint and rate limiting.

title: Click analytics endpoint
description:
Report how often each code has been used.

## Acceptance criteria

- Each successful redirect increments a click counter for that code.
- `GET /stats/{code}` returns `{"code", "url", "clicks", "created_at"}`.
- Requesting stats for an unknown code returns HTTP 404.
- Fetching stats does not itself increment the counter.
- Tests assert the counter increments once per redirect and that the stats call
  leaves it unchanged.

## Depends on

Persist links in SQLite.

title: Rate-limit code creation by IP
description:
Stop a single client from exhausting the code space.

## Acceptance criteria

- `POST /shorten` is limited to 10 requests per minute per client IP.
- Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header.
- `GET /{code}` is not rate limited.
- The limit is configurable via a `SNIPURL_RATE_LIMIT` environment variable.
- Tests assert that the 11th request within a window is rejected and that a
  request after the window succeeds.

## Depends on

Persist links in SQLite.

title: Persist links in SQLite
description:
Make shortened links survive a restart.

## Acceptance criteria

- Links are stored in SQLite; the database path is configurable via a
  `SNIPURL_DB` environment variable and defaults to `./snipurl.db`.
- A code created before a restart still resolves after it.
- Schema is created automatically on first startup; no manual migration step.
- The unique constraint on the long URL is enforced at the database level, not
  only in application code.
- Tests use a temporary database file and do not touch the developer's real one.

## Depends on

POST /shorten and GET /{code}.

title: GET /{code} - redirect with 404 handling
description:
Resolve a short code back to its target.

## Acceptance criteria

- `GET /{code}` returns HTTP 307 with a `Location` header set to the original
  URL.
- An unknown code returns HTTP 404 with a JSON error body, not an HTML page.
- A code that is the wrong length or contains invalid characters returns 404
  rather than 500.
- Tests assert the redirect status and `Location` header, and cover both 404
  paths.

## Depends on

POST /shorten.

title: POST /shorten - create a short code
description:
Accept a long URL and return a short code for it.

## Acceptance criteria

- `POST /shorten` accepts JSON `{"url": "<long-url>"}`.
- Returns HTTP 201 with `{"code": "<code>", "short_url": "<base>/<code>"}`.
- Codes are 7 characters, URL-safe, and unique across requests.
- Submitting the same long URL twice returns the same code (idempotent).
- A malformed or non-http(s) URL returns HTTP 422 with an explanatory message.
- Tests cover: happy path, idempotency, and both rejection cases.

## Depends on

Project scaffold and health endpoint.

title: Project scaffold and health endpoint
description:
Stand up the service skeleton everything else builds on.

## Acceptance criteria

- A FastAPI application starts with `uvicorn app.main:app`.
- `GET /health` returns HTTP 200 and a JSON body `{"status": "ok"}`.
- Dependencies are declared in `pyproject.toml`; the project installs cleanly
  into a fresh virtualenv.
- `pytest` runs and passes with at least one test asserting the health response
  status and body.
- Project layout is `app/` for source and `tests/` for tests.

## Notes

Blocks every other issue in this epic.
